additional_sources.role: Upstream explanation inspected; not an independent community evaluation.

adaptations: Extracted the AK SDLC specification method and content contract into one standalone package; SDLC keeps routing, state, artifact identity and readiness.
Reuses existing requirements authority and acceptance IDs; records relevant retained/changed/added behavior.
Preserves settled decisions; consequential gaps remain explicit instead of routine re-interview or invented readiness.
Removes automatic tracker publication, setup and label dependencies, exhaustive stories, fixed test-boundary counts and explicit-only invocation metadata.
Uses proportionate artifact content, caller-selected paths or task-local fallback, and no-write inline output.
Keeps planning, ticket creation, implementation and external writes with their existing owners.
runtime_requirements: Read access to the supplied requirements and relevant source; a writable authorized spec destination only for file output. No required tracker, MCP or SDLC state runtime.
validation: Strict metadata, source/license hashes, relative links and dependency closure passed. Independent bounded application covered an existing-spec update and an incomplete inline-only draft; fixture source remained unchanged. Map browser checks passed. See docs/client-verification.md. Native discovery, automatic selection, authenticated publication and full SDLC execution remain unverified.
